# Handheld F1 reference comparison: inconclusive coverage

Copied and byte-verified SD DCIM/100SIGMA/SDIM0165.DNG into diagnostics/three-k-f1-return/reference-still. SHA256b9982e555a531c7cb9661723ca68d4a1653502531c32aeee06c6a92b5f03b826,35,479,217bytes. Actual RAW6064×4042,14-bit lossless JPEG compressed, default crop6000×4000 at32,21. Metadata45mm,f/4,ISO3200,1/40s. Video reports45mm,f/4,ISO3200,1/50s. Same reported focal length does not by itself prove equal optical framing.

The still looks tighter than the video. User confirms seated in roughly the same spot and volunteers a stationary test. Do not assume the user moved closer, and do not treat this approximate handheld comparison as a calibrated measurement. Video camera pans, still tilt differs; possible camera translation, perspective and focus breathing have not been controlled.

Decoded the actual compressed still RAW using temporary rawpy0.27.1/LibRaw, not just the embedded JPEG. The tighter framing is present in the RAW too. Kept exact DNG crop origin21 (LibRaw's convenience crop rounds to22); crop phase changes green sites to0,0 and1,1. Video uses green sites0,1 and1,0 after its even crop. Green-plane images used only for registration, not calibrated RAW development.

Exploratory SIFT/RANSAC homography compares16 sampled video frames with the still, both represented at1500×1000 from their full visible crops. Best RAW comparison is frame71,114 inliers,1.263px median residual. Local scale singular values1.227/1.155 at median inlier location. These are image-registration scales under a planar model, not sensor coverage percentages. Parallax, pose, focus and scene depth prevent a unique interpretation. No full-height success/failure conclusion follows from this pair. tools/compare_f1_reference.py and reference-still/registration.json preserve method/results; comparison.jpg shows independent full image views.

Temporary dependencies installed only under/tmp/fp-f1-vision: opencv-python-headless5.0.0.93 andrawpy0.27.1. Use bundled Python <USER_HOME>/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3 for numpy/Pillow. No camera changes or new patch installation in this pass.
